lots.guide_summary: Three Gowans (Hobart) Cyclops pedal car SOLD hammers in the last 12 months, $235, $260 and $370 (the $370 included a trailer), plus one pass-in of the car that then sold at $260. No asking prices kept. All AUD, no conversion. No price found for the Dart model specifically.
lots.working: Keep: lowest same-maker SOLD = $235 (Gowans, Nov 2025). 235 / 1.22 = 192.6, rounded down to $190 hammer ($231.80 all-in). Flip: likely resale about $260 hammer (median of 235, 260, 370) sold back through a Tasmanian room, less about 15% seller commission ($39) = $221, no postage (local pickup sale). 221 / 2.44 = 90.6, rounded down to $90 hammer.
lots.confidence_reason: Cyclops badge and DART decal read clearly in the photos and three SOLD Gowans results opened with photos, but none is confirmed as the Dart model and the comparables are repainted or include a trailer, so condition match is loose.

Dropped Shannons Cyclops Chevy $800 to $1,200 estimate (page opened, dated 25 May 2016, different model, estimate only and far too old). lots.key_photo_findings: Cyclops script badge on the nose with stamped lettering below; 'Cyclops DART' arrow decal on both sides, worn and partly flaking; faded seat decal; white steering wheel; crank pedal rods and white wheels with black rubber tyres all present. Paint appears original with chips, fading and surface rust spots, not repainted.
lots.condition: Original paint, fair to good: fading, chips and light surface rust, decals worn. Appears complete (steering wheel, pedals, wheels, tyres). Pedal action and steering not shown working.
lots.question_for_armitage: Do the pedals drive the rear axle and does the steering turn freely? Any rust-through in the floor pan or missing parts (hub caps, seat, rods)? Has it ever been repainted?

Chiller: black case, two digital temperature controllers, OUT/IN/IN/OUT quick-connects, bottom drain, matching the Icemaster G20. Jerry can marked '30% Glycol 70% water'.

lots.question_for_armitage: What litre size is the fermenter, and is it the jacketed X3? What make and model is the chiller (label on the back), and does it cool and pump? Is the VEVOR stainless trolley included in the lot? Are all fittings, the lid, gauge, PRV and collection jar included?

lots.what_it_is: Hot Toys 1/4 scale (Quarter Scale series) Batman from The Dark Knight Rises, almost certainly QS001 (2013), boxed in its inner tray with Bruce Wayne head, masked lower-face head, figure with helmeted head, gold utility belt, about 8 hands and small accessories. The gold 'Quarter Scale' seal on the box was read in the photos. The researcher's DX12/DX19 (1/6 scale) identification is wrong.
lots.guide_summary: Nothing survives for the 1/4 scale QS001. All the researcher's evidence was for the 1/6 scale DX19/DX12 figure, a different and usually cheaper product. For context only (not used): actionfigure411 shows DX19 1/6 eBay sales of US$249.95 to US$400 in Jul to Oct 2026 (about $358 to $573 at 1.433), and lists an empty QS001 box alone at US$59 asking, which at least confirms the QS001 box style.
lots.working: No SOLD evidence for QS001 found: Gowans API (hot toys, batman, quarter scale) has no match; actionfigure411 has no QS001 page; Invaluable search gave no parseable results; web search was capped this turn so no further looking. Maximum bids 0.
lots.confidence_reason: Quarter Scale seal read, but no price evidence at all for this exact figure, and completeness (LED head, batteries, stand) not confirmed.
lots.dropped_entries: Dropped all eight researcher entries because they are the 1/6 scale DX19 or DX12, not this 1/4 scale QS001: actionfigure411 DX19 eBay solds US$260, US$325, US$395, US$350/359.99/400 (page opened, real 1/6 sales, wrong item; also the researcher's 1.52 rate was wrong, page shows 1.433); actionfigure411 sealed DX19 ask US$549.99; eBay.de/UK DX19 asks (snippet only, eBay closed); eBay AU DX12 ask AU$555.45 (snippet only); Vectis DX12 estimate GBP 120-150 (page opened: hammer hidden behind login, estimate only, 1/6 scale and July 2024).
lots.key_photo_findings: Gold seal on the box sleeve reads 'Quarter Scale' with the 1/4 logo, so this is the 1/4 scale line, not DX. Box sleeve shows the TDKR cowl and 'THE DARK KNIGHT RISES'. Inner tray holds figure, Bruce Wayne head, masked head, belt still on its card, about eight gloved hands, a small white accessory and a packet of spare parts. The paper tag in the photos reads 1450, not 1424.
lots.condition: Appears unused or lightly handled, in original tray with box sleeve. Not checked for loose joints, cape, stand or LED function.
lots.question_for_armitage: Please confirm it is the 1/4 scale Hot Toys QS001 Batman (the tag in the photos says 1450, the lot is 1424). Is it complete with the figure stand, cape and all accessories, and is there a brown outer shipping box? Any battery corrosion in the light-up parts?
